hero.title: Seasonal Dining & Craft Cocktails in Woodinville
paragraphs: Jackson House is a beautifully appointed dining room and whiskey-driven bar and lounge. We celebrate the best of the Pacific Northwest through intricately crafted cocktails, seasonally driven cuisine, and warm hospitality.
Our Dining Room offers a full-service restaurant experience with locally inspired, chef-driven artisanal plates designed to be shared (or not).

Our Bar & Lounge features a relaxed, small-bite-focused, self-service format, with approachable team members ensuring a smooth experience. Join us midweek for gathering nights, including Vinyl Night on Thursdays. Visit on Wednesdays for Mystery Flight Night (guess all three pours correctly for a bonus pour) and half-price bottled wine.
Reservations are available in the dining room, or stop by and enjoy our lounge experience without a reservation.

visit_questions.question: Can I visit without a reservation?
visit_questions.answer: Yes. Walk-ins are welcome in our Bar & Lounge without a reservation. Reservations are available for the full-service Dining Room.

visit_questions.question: How does lounge service work?
visit_questions.answer: Our Bar & Lounge offers a relaxed, self-service format with small plates and craft cocktails. Our team is on hand to help.

visit_questions.question: Where can I park?
visit_questions.answer: Parking is in the District Flats Apartments parking garage, with free parking validation.

visit_questions.question: What if I have dietary restrictions or food allergies?
visit_questions.answer: Please contact our team before your visit to discuss your dietary needs or food allergies and ask what options are available on the current seasonal menu.
